تعتكدوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَكِدُوا (taʕtakidū) /taʕ.ta.ki.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# تُعْتَكَدُوا (tuʕtakadū) /tuʕ.ta.ka.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
